title: Sharp Time-Varying Survivor Average Causal Effects under Death-Truncated Readmission with Monotone Mortality
banked_reason: Not salvageable within scope — bank downgraded, or re-anchor the proposal; paper_score_ceiling 6.5 < 7.4 despite a passing math panel.
gap_reasons: The exact identified-set characterization applies only after adding terminal monotonicity D(0) ≤ D(1), and does not characterize Comment et al.'s unrestricted class.

The note proves population sharpness, common fixed-cohort extrema, exact grid computation, continuous-grid convergence, and finite-sample outer containment, but proves neither shrinking outer sets nor simultaneous endpoint inference.

The marked-process functional CLT, estimated-censoring expansion, root-n grid-bias control, and multiplier validity remain open, so the advertised clinical consumer lacks a usable simultaneous inferential procedure or applied demonstration.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery established a sound terminal-monotonicity-restricted marked-capacity characterization, measurable full-law lifts, common fixed-cohort extremizers, quadratic finite-grid computation, bounded-density grid convergence, and finite-sample outer containment; the math panel passed after all cited lemmas were verified. The field-level promise collapsed because the result does not cover the motivating unrestricted class and the simultaneous inference route, shrinking-rate theorem, and applied demonstration remained open. A future re-raise should reuse the capacity graph and exact witnesses but re-anchor the proposal or supply the missing marked-process CLT, grid-bias control, multiplier validity, and application.
tldr: Death truncates readmission, so the two-index TV-SACE and RM-SACE surfaces depend on an unidentified cross-world assignment of treated readmission times to control death times. After the proved full-horizon IPCW recovery lemma identifies the complete within-arm laws, and under the additional maintained order \(D(0)\le D(1)\), the note characterizes the complete sharp monotonicity-restricted surface by a necessary-and-sufficient marked-capacity lift, proves common fixed-cohort extremizers and exact RM integration, and gives a certified three-horizon law whose joint cross-cohort support is strictly narrower than its coordinate rectangle. Quadratic chain flows, qualitative continuous-grid convergence, and deterministic-grid finite-sample outer containment make the population characterization computable. A joint marked-product-limit/IPCW functional limit, root-\(n\) grid-bias control, and simultaneous multiplier bands remain open.
gap: Comment et al. define clinically meaningful TV-SACE and RM-SACE surfaces but close the latent four-time law parametrically. Existing SACE bounds are scalar or fixed-stratum, and generic random-set or optimal-transport methods do not expose the nested readmission-marked survival constraints or joint horizon compatibility.
fill: The project supplies the if-and-only-if capacity image, constructive full-law sharpness, common extremizers, an explicit primitive separation certificate, exact computation and continuous approximation, conservative one-event finite-sample uncertainty, and a sharply isolated route to simultaneous multiplier inference.
